title: Your First Weekend at Assumption University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Arrive for First-Year Check-In
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Drive through the main gates on Salisbury Street to begin your move-in process. Faculty and student leaders wait here to welcome the new class to Hound Nation.
cards.short_summary: The official start of move-in weekend for incoming first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: First-Year Student Check-In Day is the official beginning for new students, with the community welcoming them at the Salisbury Street campus.
cards.source_title: First-Year Student Check-In Day - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Check-in typically begins in the morning; specific time slots are assigned via the student portal.

cards.title: Refuel at Taylor Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday Midday Meal
cards.notes: Visit the newly renovated dining hall for an all-you-care-to-enjoy lunch. It features 12 food concepts and a fireplace for a relaxed first meal on campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary resident dining facility on campus, recently renovated with diverse food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor Dining Hall is the primary dining venue, offering 12 concepts and continuous dining hours during the week.
cards.access_notes: Open 7:45 AM to 8:00 PM Monday-Thursday, closing at 7:00 PM on Fridays.

cards.title: Walk by the Duck Pond
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Stroll
cards.notes: Located near the main entrance, this pond is a central campus landmark. It is a quiet spot to sit and observe the resident ducks during the warmer months.
cards.short_summary: A scenic campus landmark and popular student gathering spot near La Maison Francaise.
cards.evidence_claim: The duck pond is one of the first things seen when entering campus and is a popular place for students to relax and study.
cards.source_title: Take a virtual campus tour and explore Assumption University - YouTube
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space accessible at all times.

cards.title: Explore the Student Hub
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Social
cards.notes: Head to Hagan to find the bookstore, student organization offices, and Charlie's Snack Bar. It serves as the main activity hub for the community.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for student activities, organizations, and retail dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Hagan Campus Center serves as an activity hub, housing Charlie's Snack Bar, the bookstore, and student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Charlie's Snack Bar inside is open until midnight Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Visit the Plourde Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Fitness
cards.notes: Start your Saturday with a workout or a swim. The facility includes a fitness center, indoor pool, racquetball courts, and three basketball courts.
cards.short_summary: The university's main fitness and recreation facility for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Plourde Recreation Center offers fitness equipment, an indoor pool, and courts for various sports.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; student ID required for entry.

cards.title: Grab Lunch at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Saturday Midday Bite
cards.notes: Located in the Hagan Campus Center, Charlie's offers made-to-order and grab-and-go meals. It is a popular alternative to the main dining hall.
cards.short_summary: A retail dining location offering quick meals and a social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Charlie's Snack Bar is a retail operation in the Hagan Campus Center offering a variety of meals.
cards.access_notes: Open 11:00 AM to midnight Monday-Friday; weekend hours vary by event schedule.

cards.title: Find a Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Prep
cards.notes: Locate your favorite study nook among the library's various spaces. It offers group study rooms and research guidance from professional staff.
cards.short_summary: The main academic library providing research resources and diverse study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: The Emmanuel d'Alzon Library offers a variety of study spaces, including group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM on Sundays; Saturday hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Cheer at the Stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Spirit
cards.notes: Join the Hound Pound in the stands for a home game. This multi-sport stadium features a turf field and is the center of Greyhound athletic pride.
cards.short_summary: The home field for Assumption football, lacrosse, and field hockey.
cards.evidence_claim: Brian Kelly '83 Stadium is the home for Greyhounds football and other multi-sport events.
cards.access_notes: Access is generally restricted to scheduled athletic events and games.

cards.title: Attend Sunday Mass
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Reflection
cards.notes: Participate in a community liturgy at the campus chapel. It is a central location for spiritual life and the site of many university traditions.
cards.short_summary: The primary place of worship on campus, hosting regular Catholic Masses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel of the Holy Spirit hosts regular Masses, including special community celebrations like the Mass of the Holy Spirit.
cards.source_title: Prayer and Worship on Campus - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Sunday Masses are typically held at 10:00 AM and 7:00 PM during the academic year.

cards.title: Join a Post-Mass Social
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Connection
cards.notes: After the 7 PM Mass, head to the Lauring Community Room for light refreshments and conversation. It's a great way to meet peers before the week starts.
cards.short_summary: A community space for spiritual formation, reflection, and social gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tinsley Campus Ministry Center hosts receptions after the 10 AM and 7 PM Sunday Masses in the Lauring Community Room.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry – Weekly Newsletter - The Assumptionists
cards.access_notes: The center is open 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily for prayer and reflection.
